findings.passage: “You need an ID to get on a plane, buy a lottery ticket, and drive a car,” Scott said on X. “The SAVE America Act isn’t ‘Jim Crow 2.0,’ it’s commonsense election security. What are the Democrats afraid of?!”
findings.note: Quoted by Colorado Politics from his post on X, answering a Senate leader who called the SAVE America Act 'Jim Crow 2.0'. He compares voter ID to ID needed for other everyday activities and calls the bill election security.
